requirement_text: The application must be fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of 2 seconds after startup on supported Android and iOS devices.
requirement_reference: "it is particularly important to us that the app runs quickly and smoothly so that it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting"

user_story.user_story:
As a mobile user, I want the app to be ready quickly after startup so that I can use it without delay.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the app is closed on a supported device
When I start the app
Then the application must be fully loaded and ready to use within 2 seconds.

requirement_text: The application must function reliably even with limited network coverage.
requirement_reference: "the app is developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage"

user_story.user_story:
As a mobile user, I want the app to work reliably in poor network conditions so that I can continue using it.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given network coverage is limited
When I use the app
Then the application must continue to function reliably for supported features under degraded connectivity conditions.

requirement_text: The application must remain usable offline when it temporarily loses network connection.
requirement_reference: "The app remains usable offline, even if it temporarily loses connection."

user_story.user_story:
As a mobile user, I want the app to remain usable offline so that temporary disconnections do not prevent access.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am using the app and the network connection is lost temporarily
When the app enters offline state
Then the application must remain usable for offline-supported functionality.

requirement_text: The system must support up to 100,000 simultaneous users on high-traffic match days without performance loss.
requirement_reference: "our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss"

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want the app to remain performant during peak match-day traffic so that I can use it without degradation.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given peak match-day traffic conditions
When up to 100,000 users access the system simultaneously
Then the system must continue operating without performance loss.

requirement_text: The application must undergo thorough testing and support processes before release to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
requirement_reference: "the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early"

user_story.user_story:
As a product owner, I want the app to undergo thorough pre-release testing and support so that defects are identified early.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a release candidate is prepared
When the pre-release process is executed
Then the application must complete defined testing and support activities before release.

requirement_text: The system must process all personal user data in compliance with the GDPR.
requirement_reference: "All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want my personal data handled in compliance with GDPR so that my privacy rights are protected.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the system collects, stores, or processes personal data
When data processing occurs
Then the system must process personal data in compliance with GDPR requirements.
